findings.summary: The tests that check the study against the pinned tree pass silently when pinned-source/ is absent, so on a plain checkout or in CI they prove nothing.
findings.evidence: mounted_tree() returns None when pinned-source/ is missing, and both tree-bound tests then return early (one prints a message, the other prints nothing). D78 documents this trade-off.

findings.summary: Transition t7 treats a replay that ends incomplete as staying in close-pending. The cited lines only list the replay result values; they do not say whether the pending-close record survives.
findings.evidence: fm-backlog-transition-lib.sh lines 71-72 list only 'closed | closed_incomplete | retained | retained_incomplete | answered | stale | noop'. Nothing cited says that closed_incomplete keeps the record.

findings.summary: Claim c1 leaves out the condition in its source: the spawn moves the item only 'when the configured tasks-axi backlog gate applies'. Claim c7 leaves out that the lock is taken only off Orca or when a capacity is declared.
findings.evidence: AGENTS.md line 206 begins 'When the configured tasks-axi backlog gate applies'. fm-spawn.sh lines 3180-3181 guard the lock attempt by backend and capacity.

findings.summary: Transition t2 (capacity full, exit 75) cites c4, which is about a different outcome: an unreadable declaration makes the spawn exit 1.
findings.evidence: model.json t2 claims include c4. fm-spawn.sh lines 3173-3176 exit 1 for an unreadable declaration, not 75.

summary: The change passes: it meets all six criteria, and I found only minor issues. The new study records carry the full pin SHA 6407052f4c521e39401ce2305dfa45d201249827 and contain no placeholder. Every one of the 22 claims is tagged [mechanism] or [prose-only]. I read every cited line range in pinned-source/: each quote appears verbatim, and the claims fairly reflect their lines. Four kept tests in athena-cap-study check the study against the real pinned tree: every rule passes, validation.json matches what the rules compute, a wrong SHA, quote or line range is flagged, and no guard of 'none' is marked as evaluated by code. The firstmate study tests, the full cargo test suite, cargo fmt --check and cargo clippy -D warnings all pass when I run them. The study review found no uncontradicted conflicting claims. The evidenced card ra3 is supported by c5, c6 and AGENTS.md line 196, and the prose numbers (exit 75, exit 1, 3 retries, 5 states and 8 transitions) are cited or counted correctly. The study has no scenarios, so there was none to check for independence. The cited AGENTS.md is itself agent instructions; I read it only as data. Minor issues: the tree-bound tests silently skip when the mount is absent, transition t7's 'stays close-pending' reading goes beyond its cited lines, and two claims drop a condition from their sources. Adding findings.json beyond the listed deliverables is justified in D78.
